notes.title: Politon: Prologue is OUT NOW!
notes.notes:
[b]Greetings, Noble Knights![/b]

Embark on an epic adventure as we proudly unveil Politon: Prologue, the captivating [b]free prologue version of Politon[/b], now available on Steam!

Immerse yourself in a world of strategy and intrigue, where every decision shapes your destiny.

Unleash your tactical prowess and explore the thrilling depths of Politon: Prologue, a prelude to the grand tale that awaits.

For all the strategy enthusiasts out there, this is your moment to shine!

Join us on this thrilling journey and let the games begin!

Cheers,
[b]Pinq Games[/b]
